equipment.name: 混沌爵士
equipment.bonus: 2件套：以太伤害提高10%。4件套：对处于异常状态敌人造成伤害提高20%。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: Ether DMG +10%. 4-piece: DMG to enemies with Status Ailments increased by 20%.
equipment.description: 以太系角色首选，配合异常效果输出强力。
equipment.descriptionEn: Best for Ether characters, excellent synergy with status effects.

equipment.name: 蓝调摇滚
equipment.bonus: 2件套：暴击伤害提高15%。4件套：暴击时，额外造成50%攻击力的伤害。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: CRIT DMG +15%. 4-piece: On CRIT hit, deal additional 50% ATK as DMG.
equipment.description: 暴击流角色首选，输出稳定。
equipment.descriptionEn: Best for crit-focused builds, consistent damage output.

equipment.name: 重金属风暴
equipment.bonus: 2件套：生命值上限提高15%。4件套：受到伤害时，对周围敌人造成100%攻击力的伤害。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: Max HP +15%. 4-piece: When taking DMG, deal 100% ATK as DMG to surrounding enemies.
equipment.description: 生存套装，适合高血量角色。
equipment.descriptionEn: Survival set, suitable for high HP characters.
